audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagree between layers, and the packet flags the chart as contradicting the data outright (Orianna wins 45.59% but the content chart hands her 5 of 7 stages against 0). Row 6 is the one I can resolve: content says Orianna wins with two items, while the full layer says Aurelion Sol AND the content layer's own 'late' prose says his stacked Breath of Light and empowered R out-range and out-damage her.
audit.why: Stardust permanently improves every ability, so a farmed Aurelion Sol strictly gains on Orianna the longer the game runs; a 45.59% win rate is not consistent with Orianna owning the late row. The full layer already reads Aurelion Sol there, so moving the content cell removes the disagreement rather than creating one.
audit.corrected: content win[6] moved Orianna -> Aurelion Sol to match the existing full-layer side, with whys[6] rewritten to match. Rows 1-5 deliberately left alone — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes described Orianna spiking at 6 with two unsourced magnitudes and never mentioned Falling Star.
audit.why: Falling Star is a 1250-range stun on 120/110/100 that becomes The Skies Descend once he has banked enough Stardust — that is the level-6 change in this lane.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten to Lost Chapter, his Falling Star, and Luden's as Orianna's window to press before he scales.

audit.whatIsWrong: Singularity was never mentioned anywhere on the page despite being the ability that kills Orianna: it is a 12s, 750-range black hole that pulls, grants him Stardust per second you are inside, and executes below a percent-health threshold. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit, and the packet counted zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Percent-health execution means armour and MR are the wrong purchase, and standing in the hole actively feeds his permanent scaling — two facts that reverse the instinct to tank the zone and walk out.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now states the execute threshold; breakdown.cooldowns carries Astral Flight at 22s rank 1 and Singularity at 12s with a wait-for-X line; dosFull[1].d sequences the trade off the spent 22s flight.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four lint findings: two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d), an unsupported 'doubles every gank', and a cooldowns field with no number.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol wins by landing Astral Flight, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol wins by farming Stardust unpunished, then out-ranging you with a stacked Breath of Light and a 1250-range stun.

edits.before: Ahead, run the clock: shove with Q-W, zone Aurelion Sol off every contact with ball threat, and rotate first to rivers — your Shockwave makes every skirmish a 5v4 audition.
edits.after: Ahead, run the clock: shove with Q-W, deny every Stardust stack he reaches for, and force fights early — Shockwave lands cleanly while a 22s Astral Flight is spent.

edits.before: Win the auto-weave levels: passive stacks hurt, ball placement zones, and Q-W trades punish every wave contact. Mana is the only brake.
edits.after: Win the auto-weave levels: he is immobile with 750-range chip poke, so punish every step-up and deny Stardust. Mana is the only brake.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball carries a shield, speed and your R into every gank.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Command: Protect has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1; while it is down he is a stationary battery, so step up only after he has spent it. - Singularity is 12s and executes below a percent threshold. - E Command: Protect (9s) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Lost Chapter steadies the trade game; level 6 doubles your lane presence; Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar.
edits.after: Lost Chapter steadies the trade game; his level 6 Falling Star adds a stun and burst; Luden's is your window to press.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 — once he has spent it, Q-W the wave contact and auto twice before he can reposition out.

edits.before: That is Aurelion Sol’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: An idle ball is a free Singularity on your feet — hold it close.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Singularity's centre executes below a percent-health threshold — track the number, not the bar, and never linger in the hole.

edits.before: Track Aurelion Sol’s Astral Flight: His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Aurelion Sol’s Astral Flight: 22s at rank 1, his reposition and his escape. While it is down he is a stationary battery — step up then.

edits.before: You stay ahead in lane as long as you deny stacks, though his late scaling is the real threat.
edits.after: His stacked Breath of Light and empowered R out-range and out-damage you once the game goes long.

notes: QUESTION FOR THE USER, and the reason I touched only one chart row: the packet itself flags this chart as contradicting the data — Orianna wins 45.59% here, yet the content chart gives her 5 of 7 stages and Aurelion Sol none. The two layers also disagree on six of seven rows (full: Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Aurelion Sol; content and packet: Orianna/Skill/Skill/Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Orianna). I could not decide rows 1-5 from the kit — nothing in either kit says whether the 4-6 window is Orianna's or even — so I left every one of those sides alone per the chart rule. I did move content win[6] to Aurelion Sol: the full layer already said so, the content layer's own 'late' paragraph says so, and a sub-50% win rate is not consistent with Orianna owning the two-item row; whys[6] was rewritten in the same proposal to match. FLAG on the kit file: Astral Flight carries a derived 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag, but Riot's text says he FLIES OVER terrain — he does not create any. The _missing entry built on that flag ('can cut your retreat with Astral Flight — hold Flash for the wall') is therefore wrong, and I did not write it anywhere. Ratings left as found.
